purpose: Ten full selection resamples within HTRU2 first outer training pool; development only
resampling: Class-stratified rows without replacement; groups remain disjoint at every validation boundary
randomness: Vary row resampling, inner partitions and selector seeds together; conditional combined stability, not isolated data-only stability
final_stage: Rebuild all four selectors on each full resample; save eight chosen feature sets and budgets; no final classifier or held-out evaluation needed for feature stability
inference: Descriptive only; no tests or confidence intervals; 45 pairs do not constitute 45 independent runs
